name: Unreal Tournament
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: The 1999 arena shooter, Game of the Year edition, with OldUnreal's community patch. It also uses the port after the server's port for the server browser, so add that one too. Other settings are in System/UnrealTournament.ini.
startup: cd System && exec ./ucc-bin server "{{MAP}}?Game={{GAME_TYPE}}?MaxPlayers={{MAX_PLAYERS}}" port={{SERVER_PORT}} ini=UnrealTournament.ini userini=User.ini -nohomedir

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Unreal Tournament (GOTY) with OldUnreal's patch, installed as OldUnreal's
# own Linux installer does: the game CD image from OldUnreal's mirrors (free
# to download, with Epic's blessing), Bonus Pack 4, then the patch for this
# CPU from GitHub, all checked against their SHA-256. Your settings
# (System/UnrealTournament.ini, User.ini) and anything you add are never
# overwritten.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
ua="raptor-installer (+https://raptorpanel.net)"
build=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
trap 'rm -rf "$build"' EXIT
rm -rf "$build" && mkdir -p "$build"

case "$(uname -m)" in
x86_64) arch=amd64; zarch=x64 ;;
aarch64) arch=arm64; zarch=arm64 ;;
*) fail "Unreal Tournament's server runs on x86-64 and ARM64 machines only." ;;
esac

want=${VERSION:-latest}
[ "$want" = latest ] || want="v${want#v}"
tag=$(gh-release tag OldUnreal/UnrealTournamentPatches "$want") ||
    fail "OldUnreal patch ${VERSION} doesn't exist. Check Version and reinstall."
patch=$(gh-release assets OldUnreal/UnrealTournamentPatches "$tag" | awk -v a="-Linux-$arch.tar.bz2" '$1 ~ a"$" && !f { print $1; f = 1 }')
[ -n "$patch" ] || fail "OldUnreal patch $tag has no Linux build for $arch."

# Downloads <file> from OldUnreal's mirrors, checked against its SHA-256.
mirror() {
    local name=$1 sum=$2 out=$3 host
    for host in files.oldunreal.net files2.oldunreal.net files3.oldunreal.net; do
        if curl -fsSL --retry 2 -A "$ua" -o "$out" "https://$host/$name" &&
            [ "$(sha256sum "$out" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = "$sum" ]; then
            return 0
        fi
        echo "The download from $host failed or didn't match its checksum; trying the next mirror."
    done
    fail "None of OldUnreal's mirrors gave a good copy of $name. Reinstall to try again."
}

# 7-Zip, only for unpacking the CD image; not kept.
seven() {
    [ -x "$build/7z/7zzs" ] && return 0
    local t
    t=$(gh-release tag ip7z/7zip latest) || fail "GitHub can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
    gh-release download ip7z/7zip "$t" "7z${t//./}-linux-$zarch.tar.xz" "$build/7z.tar.xz" ||
        fail "7-Zip couldn't be downloaded from GitHub. Reinstall to try again."
    mkdir -p "$build/7z" && tar -xJf "$build/7z.tar.xz" -C "$build/7z" 7zzs
}

# Copies the files under $1 into the server folder, never replacing one
# that's already there (your settings, and the patch's newer files).
merge() { (cd "$1" && find . -type f -print0) | while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
    [ -e "$f" ] || { mkdir -p "$(dirname "$f")" && mv "$1/$f" "$f"; }
done; }

iso_sum=e184984ca88f001c5ddd52035d76cd64e266e26c74975161b5ed72366c74704f
bp4_sum=5b7a1080724a122a596c226c50d4dc7c2d7636ceaf067e9c12112014a170ffba
if [ "$(cat .raptor-game 2>/dev/null)" != "$iso_sum $bp4_sum" ]; then
    seven
    echo "Downloading Unreal Tournament GOTY (the 620 MB game CD image)"
    mirror UT_GOTY_CD1.ISO "$iso_sum" "$build/cd1.iso"
    echo "Downloading Bonus Pack 4"
    mirror utbonuspack4-zip.7z "$bp4_sum" "$build/bp4.7z"
    mkdir -p "$build/game"
    # Everything but the Windows setup, programs and default settings,
    # as OldUnreal's installer does.
    "$build/7z/7zzs" x -y -bd -o"$build/game" "$build/cd1.iso" \
        -x'!System/UnrealTournament.ini' -x'!System/User.ini' -x'!System/*.bat' -x'!System/*.dll' \
        -x'!System/*.exe' -x'!Autorun.inf' -x'!Setup.exe' -x'!DirectX7' -x'!Microsoft' -x'!System400' >/dev/null ||
        fail "The game CD image couldn't be unpacked. Reinstall to try again."
    "$build/7z/7zzs" x -y -bd -o"$build/game" "$build/bp4.7z" >/dev/null ||
        fail "Bonus Pack 4 couldn't be unpacked. Reinstall to try again."
    rm -f "$build/cd1.iso" "$build/bp4.7z"
    # The patch replaces these, and the game's must not stay behind.
    rm -f .raptor-version
    merge "$build/game"
    echo "$iso_sum $bp4_sum" > .raptor-game
fi

if [ "$(cat .raptor-version 2>/dev/null)" = "$tag" ] && [ -x System/ucc-bin ]; then
    echo "OldUnreal's patch $tag is already installed."
else
    echo "Downloading OldUnreal's patch $tag for $arch"
    gh-release download OldUnreal/UnrealTournamentPatches "$tag" "$patch" "$build/patch.tar.bz2" ||
        fail "The patch download from GitHub failed. Reinstall to try again."
    mkdir -p "$build/patch"
    tar -xjf "$build/patch.tar.bz2" -C "$build/patch"
    # The patch's own files replace the game's (fonts, textures, programs).
    cp -a "$build/patch/." .
    echo "$tag" > .raptor-version
fi

# Old patches kept the programs in System64 or SystemARM64; they now live in System.
for d in System64 SystemARM64; do
    [ -d "$d" ] || continue
    for f in "$d"/*; do [ -f "$f" ] && [ ! -e "System/${f##*/}" ] && mv "$f" System/; done
    rm -rf "$d"
done

# Maps come compressed (.uz) on the CD; the server needs them unpacked.
shopt -s nullglob
uz=(Maps/*.unr.uz)
if [ ${#uz[@]} -gt 0 ]; then
    echo "Unpacking ${#uz[@]} maps"
    for f in "${uz[@]}"; do
        m=${f##*/}; m=${m%.uz}
        if [ ! -f "Maps/$m" ]; then
            (cd System && ./ucc-bin decompress "../$f" -nohomedir >/dev/null 2>&1) && [ -f "System/$m" ] ||
                fail "The map $m couldn't be unpacked. Reinstall to try again."
            mv -f "System/$m" "Maps/$m"
        fi
        rm -f "$f"
    done
fi
# DM-Cybrosis][ is also a Domination map, as OldUnreal's installer sets up.
[ ! -f "Maps/DM-Cybrosis][.unr" ] || [ -f "Maps/DOM-Cybrosis][.unr" ] || cp "Maps/DM-Cybrosis][.unr" "Maps/DOM-Cybrosis][.unr"

# The server's settings start from the patch's defaults, as the game does on
# its first start; the Panel sets the port, name and passwords at each start.
[ -f System/UnrealTournament.ini ] || cp System/Default.ini System/UnrealTournament.ini
[ -f System/User.ini ] || cp System/DefUser.ini System/User.ini
# No match stats sent to the long-gone ngWorldStats service.
grep -q '^bWorldLog=' System/UnrealTournament.ini ||
    sed -i 's/^\[Engine.GameInfo\]\r\?$/&\nbWorldLog=False/' System/UnrealTournament.ini
chmod +x System/ucc-bin System/ucc-bin-* 2>/dev/null || true
echo "Installed Unreal Tournament GOTY with OldUnreal's patch $tag."

variables.name: Version
variables.description: OldUnreal's patch, such as v469e, or latest for the newest one. Players need a 469 patch too. Reinstall the server after changing it.

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name players see in the server browser.

variables.name: Map
variables.description: The map the server starts on, such as DM-Deck16][ or CTF-Face; it must suit the game type.

variables.name: Game type
variables.description: The game type: Botpack.DeathMatchPlus, Botpack.TeamGamePlus, Botpack.CTFGame, Botpack.Domination, Botpack.Assault or Botpack.LastManStanding, or a mod's.

variables.name: Max players
variables.description: How many players can be on the server at once.

variables.name: Password
variables.description: The password players join with. Empty, anyone can join.

variables.name: Admin password
variables.description: The password for adminlogin, which gives a player admin commands. Empty turns it off.

variables.name: Public
variables.description: True lists the server on the master servers so players find it; False keeps it unlisted.
